# Urban Planning × Agents Papers (2025-Present)

A curated list of top-conference and top-journal papers on **Urban Planning × Agents** published from **2025-01-01** onward.

> Last updated: 2026-04-03  
> Scope: urban planning, planning support, urban behavior simulation, multi-agent systems, agentic LLMs, and closely related planner-oriented systems.  
> Note: `Code` may include **GitHub / Project / Model / Demo** links when source code is not publicly available. `-` means no public link was found at the time of collection.
